title: QUIC server first-flight x25519 key-share compatibility work item
summary: Add the narrow managed TLS server branch that accepts an advertised usable x25519 first-flight key share, publishes an x25519 ServerHello, and keeps unsupported hybrid groups and interop promotion out of scope.
planned_changes:
- Add x25519 as a server first-flight named-group candidate without changing the client-generated ClientHello profile.
- Teach ClientHello parsing to accept exactly one advertised, well-formed x25519 key_share and to ignore unsupported hybrid entries.
- Keep duplicate, malformed, or unadvertised x25519 key shares on the fatal path.
- Teach the server key schedule to construct an x25519 ServerHello and derive Handshake secrets from the x25519 ECDHE shared secret.
- Preserve the existing secp256r1 HelloRetryRequest fallback when no usable first-flight supported share exists and secp256r1 was advertised.
- Keep public API, IsSupported, HTTP/3, anti-replay, hybrid groups, general group negotiation, and interop support promotion out of scope.
verification_plan: Run focused REQ_QUIC_CRT_0154 and REQ_QUIC_CRT_0147 requirement-home tests first, then SpecTrace core validation, Release build, full Release tests, and diff whitespace checks.
completion_notes: Implemented the bounded managed-server first-flight x25519 branch. ClientHello parsing now accepts exactly one advertised well-formed x25519 key share, ignores unsupported hybrid key-share entries, rejects duplicate, malformed, or unadvertised x25519 entries, and leaves the secp256r1 HRR fallback in REQ-QUIC-CRT-0147. The server key schedule now publishes an x25519 ServerHello and derives Handshake packet-protection material from x25519 ECDHE for the accepted branch. Focused REQ_QUIC_CRT_0154, REQ_QUIC_CRT_0147, and REQ_QUIC_CRT_0112 coverage passed 31/31 locally. Public API, IsSupported, HTTP/3, anti-replay, hybrid groups, general group negotiation, and interop zerortt promotion remain out of scope until separate proof.
out_of_scope: interop zerortt support promotion without live runner proof
